query: WITH unit_ref(series_name, chapter_order, title) AS ( VALUES ('C', 1, 'TRAVEL AND WORLD TOURISM'), ('C', 2, 'NATURAL RESOURCES'), ('C', 3, 'DEADLY VIRUSES AND DISEASES'), ('C', 4, 'CRIME AND VIOLENCE'), ('C', 5, 'HUMAN RIGHTS'), ('C', 6, 'TECHNOLOGY AND OUR LIVES'), ('D', 1, 'TRAVEL AND WORLD TOURISM'), ('D', 2, 'NATURAL RESOURCES'), ('D', 3, 'DEADLY VIRUSES AND DISEASES'), ('D', 4, 'CRIME AND VIOLENCE'), ('D', 5, 'HUMAN RIGHTS'), ('D', 6, 'TECHNOLOGY AND OUR LIVES') ) INSERT INTO lessons (chapter_id, title, content, description, display_order, is_active, is_test_data) SELECT c.id, unit_ref.title, '', '', 1, false, false FROM unit_ref JOIN levels lev ON lev.name = 'Première' JOIN series se ON se.name = unit_ref.series_name JOIN subjects s ON s.name = 'Anglais' JOIN course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id = lev.id AND o.series_id = se.id AND o.subject_id = s.id JOIN chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id = o.id AND c.display_order = unit_ref.chapter_order WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lessons le WHERE le.chapter_id = c.id AND le.title = unit_ref.title) RETURNING id;
